research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Sorting Robotics is researching automated deposition of highly viscous fluids into thin walled cylinders through systems and methods for automatic infusion of concentrate and distillate material into cigarettes or other containers. The title Automated deposition of highly viscous fluids into thin walled cylinders and its abstract describe thermally controlled infusion that maintains a selected temperature and precisely injects concentrate, highlighting work in automated cannabis and hemp infusion processes.
